description: This file defines a PHP interface named HelpProcessor within the OrangeHRM\Help\Processor namespace. It specifies method signatures for retrieving various URLs related to help processing, such as base URL, search URL, redirect URL, and default redirect URL, but does not implement these methods.

classes.name: HelpProcessor
classes.description: A PHP interface outlining the methods for processing help-related URLs in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL as a string.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Returns a search URL for a given label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns a redirect URL for a given label.
